value.rationale: An exact threshold separates regimes where the resetting clock makes a fluctuating rotational drift less or more predictable relative to its mean. The all-rate unique optimum and arbitrarily large relative improvement near critical confinement are a natural, physically motivated signal-to-noise classification, not an arbitrary finite table or known special case.
